newsitem.title: UK: Average discount rate at UK T-bill tender 6.5774%.
newsitem.headline: Average discount rate at UK T-bill tender 6.5774%.

text.p: The average rate of discount at the weekly tender of 91-day UK Treasury bills rose to 6.5774 percent from 6.5951 percent last week, the Bank of England said on Friday. The 200 million stg offer attracted bids of 1.178 billion stg. The pro rata price was 98.355 percent. Next week 200 million stg of 91-day bills will be on offer as well as 300 million stg of 28-day bills. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7708
